HistoryStrip buttons dispatch select-history; reducer changes selectedHistoryId only, not layers, source, selection or other document content. Compare tab merely slices last four metadata rows; ResultThumbnail draws tone CSS spans, not source images. Actual undo/redo is a separate real snapshot mechanism.

additionalCapabilities.testCoverageNote: No original audit test proved clicking a history thumbnail restores document pixels; newly added concurrent tests are not evidence until run

additionalCapabilities.behavior: Observed duplicate-layer shallow-copies Layer fields and allocates layer-Date.now ID; source-only image is reused. brushStrokes/canvasTexts/canvasShapes/layerMasks/sceneOrder are separate tables and are not cloned or remapped. Group children/groupId references are copied unchanged. Nested adjustments/transform metadata initially shares references; selectedLayerIds remains previous selection. Thus this is not complete editable layer/group duplication.

additionalCapabilities.export: duplicate imported source may look correct; drawn/text/shape/mask-only copy loses content; group copy may refer to original children
